scholar: The prosecution at Herat (Zayn al-Dīn Khwāfī and the establishment opponents), as reported by Melvin-Koushki
title: The suspected Ḥurufī
summary: A subversive esotericist: a 'neo-bāṭinī' and possible Ḥurufī sympathiser, whose lettrism, teacher and friends put him on the wrong side of a state alarmed by mystical-messianic extremism. The accusers' own arguments are not on the pages read; this model is assembled from the label and its consequences, and from Melvin-Koushki's account of how it was used, not from anything the accusers wrote. No source read calls Ibn Turka himself a Ḥurufī.
